# Concept

To improve the realism and coverage of concert sound systems



# Patching{.tabset}

## dLive

```diagram

```

- When using the Adamson Fletcher Machine, we use the AFM as a mix bus renderer.  This mix bus has as many channels as you have loudspeakers.

1. Patch the virtual soundcheck to the system using Dante channels 1-64 (32 can be used at 96kHz if required)
2. Patch the Input Direct Output to on Dante Channels 1-64.  This will be sent to the Fletcher Machine.
3. Set the direct output routing to follow mutes (ALL) and to be post delay.

![afm_direct_out_routing.png](/adamson/afm_direct_out_routing.png)

4. Patch *Mix Ext In* (Dante Channels 65-96) to inject the signal directly into the Mono Matrix.  This is used for monitoring and/or special level adjustments if needed.
5. Assign a DCA to control the level of all outputs at once.
![dca_routing.png](/adamson/dca_routing.png)

> If recording is required, it is reccomended to use another I/O card, and patch via Tie Lines.
{.is-warning}
